title: SHINY OBJECT SYNDROME // BUT WHAT ABOUT THE FLEET?
narrative: Daenerys soars high above the Sunset Sea atop Drogon. Below them, ninety-four colossal ironborn warships with kraken banners shoot scorpion bolts into the sky. 'Oh, look at that fluffy cloud over there!' Daenerys exclaims, pointing at a cumulonimbus shaped like a bunny. 'It is so pretty!' She completely forgets the enemy armada is firing ballistas at her dragons, flies through the cloud, and lands in a meadow to make daisy chains.
resolvesPlotHole: Dany Kind of Forgot About the Iron Fleet
introducesPlotHole: Severe Tactical Amnesia Due to Fluffy Clouds

options.text: Return to Meereen and untie the knot by force.
Let Victarion's smoking arm commandeer the airspace.
